codex.mcanomalyarchives.title: The Archive
codex.mcanomalyarchives.locked_hint: Not yet deciphered. It is recorded automatically once you encounter it.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.planned: This anomaly is not implemented in the mod yet; the file is incomplete.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo001.name: Fake Cloud
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo001.info: A high-altitude anomaly shaped like a vanilla cloud. Three types - Ghost, Polymorph and Displaced - and it escapes through blocks. Its grey-blue fluid makes things phase out.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo001.trait: Arrows pass through, then it flees faster · Glass cages cannot hold it · Animals inside suffocate · Water and lava stain grey-blue · Black individuals erase nearby blocks on contact
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo002.name: The Village That Isn't
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo002.info: An inverted-colour village that only exists inside a specific rectangle of coordinates. Its villagers keep staring at you.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo002.trait: Invisible from outside the zone · Inverted colours, wrong materials · Villagers have no recognisable face · Trespassers turn inverted · The 「disaster」 traded from them makes the buyer vanish
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo003.name: Corn Poppy
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo003.info: A poppy that makes you addicted to watching it. Look straight at it and you weep for no reason; onlookers have died.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo003.trait: Affects a 128-block diameter · Viewing through cameras blocks the effect · Secreting tears at hour 41 drove two researchers to suicide · New instances grow from the faces of dead watchers
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo004.name: Dimensional Fishing Rod
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo004.info: Looks like an ordinary rod, yet it can pull things from outside the Overworld ashore.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo004.trait: Durability cap around 8.98x10^17, one point per cast · The further you cast, the stranger the catch · Catches are inedible or dangerous · A black fisherman's shadow keeps appearing nearby
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo005.name: Purple Monster
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo005.info: A purple one-eyed humanoid in deep woods. It talks inside your head, pushes you toward negative options, and slowly assimilates you.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo005.trait: Its face is replaced by a single eye · Speaks mentally through an option window · Those who choose negative options turn purple · It vanishes in disgust when watched · Grows tendrils that impale
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo006.name: The Ore Cave
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo006.info: A bottomless, layered cave in the forest. The deeper you go the richer the ore - greed keeps you digging.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo006.trait: Six stages, from I Glimmer to VI Black Hole · Absurd veins, up to 822 iron in one · Attached anomalies: enriched ore, white miner ghosts, the thing you seek, the visionary golden gate · Old diggings vanish and the layout resets · Treasure taken out turns to ash
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo007.name: Negative Items
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo007.info: A set of inverted-colour drops with negative stack counts, anti-properties and a retroactive effect.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo007.trait: Counts are negative, colours inverted · A negative apple lowers hunger and multiplies · A negative pickaxe gains durability and randomises blocks · Negative leggings cannot be removed and summon negative entities · Replaced blocks reappear in a nearby cave
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo008.name: Shapeshifting Name Tag
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo008.info: A dark brown anomalous name tag recovered from a minecart cache inside a mineshaft. It inverts the causality of naming: a thing is not named after its properties - its properties are rewritten to match the name.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo008.trait: Changes the core, never the shell - Items and blocks must be named through an anvil - Naming is irreversible; ordinary name tags cannot overwrite it - A named creature slowly becomes the thing its name points to - Item conversion obeys material conservation and pays any deficit with an explosion - The number of extant tags is [DATA EXPUNGED]
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo009.name: The False Sun
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo009.info: A higher-dimensional projected body, visible only to the mentally ill. It anchors to reality through gaze and magnifies the watcher's desire.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo009.trait: Visible only to the mentally ill · Anchors to reality by being watched; focus sharpens it · Magnifies inner desire, then brings calm · Its form follows the watcher's illness · Can rewrite collective perception
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo010.name: Dimensional Spyglass
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo010.info: A grey telescope whose five dials let you see into other dimensions. Some images carry memetic contamination.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo010.trait: A grey telescope whose material much resembles UO-004 · Five dials α to ε below; δ and ε are broken · α shifts deviation from reality, β time, γ image density · Some images carry dangerous memetics causing extreme fear · A second viewing by the same person causes blindness
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo011.name: Strange Tree
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo011.info: A black tree that burrows and lies in wait, then kills whoever fells trees nearby. Bedrock can trap it.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo011.trait: Trunk is near-bedrock hard · Leaves near-obsidian, regrowing instantly · After 7 to 9 trees felled it uproots and burrows · Approaches underground at about 3.1 m/s and cuts with scythe-like branches · Replanting one sapling per tree prevents it
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo012.name: Lucky Pink Sheep
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo012.info: A motionless pink sheep. Its first witness may later experience a fortunate coincidence. It remains while someone watches.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.uo012.trait: Two seconds confirms the first witness · A contextual lucky chain starts after 15–45 seconds and resolves about 3 seconds after its cue · Relocates when nobody watches · Staggered blinks help, but prolonged observation can cause shared eye fatigue · Approaching within 10/8/3 blocks or attacking triggers calamities
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note_added: The archive has recorded another property of %s.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.encounter.UO-001: Cloud-shaped individuals float overhead. A closer look reveals they are not ordinary clouds.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.encounter.UO-002: Unrelated objects overlap. The characters in their name keep changing.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.encounter.UO-003: A familiar-looking poppy. Looking away is unexpectedly difficult.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.encounter.UO-004: An ordinary-looking fishing rod. Its catches remain to be investigated.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.encounter.UO-005: A humanoid appeared nearby. It seems aware of my presence.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.encounter.UO-008: A tag that accepts a written name. The significance of the name remains untested.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.encounter.UO-011: A seemingly ordinary tree, with differences that become apparent up close.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.encounter.UO-012: A pink sheep. Events around me began to feel unusual when I looked at it.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.cloud_small: Smaller cloud individuals have been seen moving through the air. Their size is not an effect of distance.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.cloud_black: A black cloud individual was sighted. Its coloration differs clearly; other properties remain unconfirmed.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.garbled_spr: While a menu containing a garbled object was open, another stack became garbled. The same menu appears to define its reach.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.poppy_addic: Looking at the poppy caused an addictive response. The influence persisted after looking away.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.fishing_cat: The rod brought back something outside the usual catch. The water may connect elsewhere.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.fishing_far: An unusually distant cast produced a stronger disturbance. Casting distance may matter.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.purple_arri: After remaining still while weakened or mentally strained, a humanoid appeared and initiated contact.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.purple_chan: The humanoid changed color and posture during our conversation. Its initial appearance is not fixed.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.purple_assi: The encounter left a lasting influence. Its attention did not end with the conversation.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.purple_stal: It was seen watching from afar. After noticing my gaze, it remained briefly before leaving.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.purple_rewa: A purple tentacle remained after contact. It is a persistent object, not merely an image from that encounter.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.name_rewrit: An object rewritten by the tag was encountered. Its name appears connected to its properties.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.name_garble: A name referring to no known object caused garbling. Arbitrary words are also acted upon.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.name_mining: A creature named Diamond Pickaxe began searching for ore. It reacted to the name of a tool.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.name_erase: The individual named Nothing vanished without an ordinary death.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.name_mimic: After receiving an online player's name, the target began imitating that player's actions.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.tree_chase: The tree was seen entering or emerging from the ground. Its location is not fixed.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.sheep_bless: A blessing followed observation of the pink sheep. It appears connected with good fortune.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.sheep_calam: An event associated with the sheep escalated into calamity. Previous luck did not guarantee safety.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.sheep_blink: The watched sheep vanished abruptly, without walking away.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.cloud_conta: Entering the cloud's area of influence caused injury. Its soft appearance does not make contact safe.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.cloud_trans: Liquid near the cloud changed. Ordinary water or lava was replaced by cloud water or cloud stone.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.cloud_red: A red small cloud was sighted. Similar shape does not establish identical properties.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.cloud_erase: Blocks disappeared near a passing black cloud without leaving corresponding drops.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.poppy_withd: A sadness response followed looking away from the poppy. Its influence was not easily shaken off.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.fishing_liv: The rod brought back a living creature. An entire individual passed through the water's surface.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.purple_pet: Another animal appeared during the encounter. Touching it was followed by another transformation of the purple individual.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.name_absorb: A named creature took matching materials from its surroundings. The transformation affects physical objects nearby.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.name_compre: An unstable named object exploded when used. The requested change appears to have exceeded what the original object could support.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.tree_replan: Planting a sapling during pursuit interrupted the tree's tracking. Replanting appears connected with its response.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.tree_exposu: The tree began burrowing after much of its root area became exposed. Ground cover affects whether it stays.
item.mcanomalyarchives.uo002_garbled.too: An error item gradually infects items in the same open interface.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.negative_ap: Eating a negative apple deepened hunger, while the number of negative apples increased.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.negative_pi: The negative diamond pickaxe barely wore down. Nearby stone changed, and a displaced stone later appeared in a nearby cave.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.negative_bo: Releasing the negative bow produced no outgoing arrow. Instead, an ordinary arrow returned to my inventory.
After a delay, an arrow flew back at high speed from the aimed direction toward its shooter. Releasing the bow was not the end of the shot.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.negative_di: The disc muffled the surrounding sounds. Colours inverted and a ripple crossed the frozen space.
Blocks, creatures and items within roughly fifty blocks returned to the recorded past, up to ten seconds ago. My discoveries remained.
Rewinding cannot repair the disc itself. Each successful rewind uses one charge; it vanishes after ten uses.
message.mcanomalyarchives.rewind.warming: No past recorded yet. Wait briefly near the jukebox, then reinsert. Available history is rewound, up to ten seconds.
message.mcanomalyarchives.rewind.chunks: Surrounding chunks are not loaded. Cancelled without wear.
message.mcanomalyarchives.rewind.machine: A nearby block entity cannot be fully recorded. Cancelled without wear.
message.mcanomalyarchives.rewind.menu: Transient crafting inputs interrupted recording. Clear the crafting grid, close the menu and wait briefly.
message.mcanomalyarchives.rewind.boundar: Objects or items crossed the rewind boundary during the last ten seconds. Cancelled without wear.
message.mcanomalyarchives.rewind.busy: Too many changes to record, or another rewind is active. No wear applied.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.negative_bl: Placing a negative block leaves black space instead of its material. It dissolves gradually and vanishes after about thirty seconds.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.negative_sp: Touching the black space causes lethal damage.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.negative_bl: After the negative space dissolved, its ordinary material reappeared in an empty spot in a nearby cave.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.name_liquid: Cobblestone named water spread into a sticky grey layer and evaporated into dust. It dissipated after about eleven minutes.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.name_potato: The creature named potato stopped moving, gradually became tuber-like, sprouted and finally left potatoes behind.
message.mcanomalyarchives.earth.active: An Earth anomaly is already active in this dimension. The name tag was not consumed.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.name_earth: The accepted name warped local space with yellow light. The event persisted independently of its anchor.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.earth_pull: Gravity dragged me toward the collapsing ground. Escaping became harder closer to the center.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.earth_blast: After the crater formed, its center exploded and hurled rock and dirt outward. Attraction and collapse stopped at the blast.
codex.mcanomalyarchives.note.earth_rewin: Only a record preceding the naming removes Earth. Rewinding to a later point merely delays the catastrophe.
